text:
You throw an old, heavy vase at
the mirror, shattering it. The
ghosts of Seth and Tabitha Rosen
appear in front of you.
“Thank you. You are a good soul”,
says Tabitha, and hands you a
folded piece of parchment. You
shiver at the touch of the ghost’s
cold, semi-immaterial fingers.
You unfold the parchment. There
is some sort of magical symbol
drawn in dark brown ink. If you
were cursed, the curse is lifted,
and the protection offered by this
amulet lets you recover 3 Sanity
points.
Seth explains to you that there was
an occult war between their coven
of good witches and a dark coven
of children who worshippedSnowy Samuel, a white goat with
red eyes. The only way to stop the
Snowy Samuel cult was to kill the
children in a ritual.
“Our souls will scream for all
eternity for what we have done…
but there was no other way”. Seth
explains that the seven children
were hanged from the tree and
buried next to its roots.
“Do not dig their graves, because
they are powerful even in death
and may return to haunt the
world.”
Before you can ask any additional
questions, the ghosts of Seth and
Tabitha disappear in a black mist.
Return to your exploration.

zh-CN.title: 22 - 打碎暗镜
text:
你拿起一只沉重的旧花瓶砸向镜子，将它击碎。塞斯和塔比莎·罗森的鬼魂出现在你面前。
“谢谢你。你是个善良的人。”塔比莎说着，递给你一张折叠的羊皮纸。鬼魂半透明、冰冷的手指碰到你时，你不禁打了个寒颤。
你展开羊皮纸，上面用深褐色墨水画着某种魔法符号。如果你受到了诅咒，诅咒便会解除；护符的庇佑还会使你恢复3点理智。
塞斯向你解释，他们善良女巫的集会曾与一个邪恶教团交战；那群孩子崇拜一只红眼白山羊雪诺·塞缪尔。阻止雪诺·塞缪尔教团的唯一办法，就是在仪式中杀死这些孩子。
“为了我们所做的一切，我们的灵魂会永远哀号……但那是唯一的办法。”塞斯解释说，7个孩子被吊死在树上，埋在树根旁。
“不要挖他们的坟。他们死后依然强大，可能会回来祸害世间。”
你还没来得及追问，塞斯和塔比莎的鬼魂就化作黑雾消失了。回到小镇继续探索。
